W.note: Clean, compact and correct with a score tally and clear win highlight, but cell labels do not announce marks and there is no focus style.

X.note: Nicest SVG marks, dark mode and arrow keys, but it adds an unrequested computer opponent and loser-starts rule, and the bottom row collapses once marks are placed.

Y.note: Exactly a basic game with a stable board, strong contrast, dark mode, focus rings, descriptive labels and a live status, and no layout glitches.

Z.note: Simple and tidy with a nice framed board, but the board rows distort after moves, cell labels are only Cell n, and there is no focus-visible polish for marks.
